games.name: Forest Grind 🌲
games.desc:
Step into the boots of a lumberjack in Forest Grind, a first-person forestry game. Start with a basic axe, chop trees, and sell wood to pay off your $60,000 debt.

💵 Accept or decline deals to increase your earnings
🔧 Upgrade your tools to improve speed and efficiency
🏗️ Build bases and hire workers to automate your operation
🚁 Purchase a drone that automatically picks up logs for you
📈 Expand your business and grow into a forest tycoon
🐶 Buy a robodog companion just for fun

From swinging your first axe to running a full-scale operation, experience forestry up close!

🔧 Update - 16.03.2026
• Added Playtime System
• Small game improvements and adjustments
• Game optimized for better performance.
